eligibility: Only an interrupted G3 writer after seven earlier hypotheses and fourteen earlier judgments are complete; reuse every previously successful exact named request.
completion: Complete at most the one or two originally scheduled missing G3 writer requests, then their original G3 judgments; never regenerate earlier hypotheses or resample completed judgments.
retry_seed: Continue original recorded failed-attempt count; do not repeat the failed attempt-zero seed.
same_conditions: Frozen protocol, evidence, engine, configuration, model and effort; applicable consistently when this failure occurs in either arm.
when: Only after the original 16-slot pair finishes.
reporting: Retain the original failed run. Put completion results in a separate canonical one-time folder. Preserve unknown usage and do not claim that the original time or exact token cap was met.
